name: vanessa
root: Run Gherkin UI scenarios through Vanessa Automation; yaxunit_tests tests code. Choose exactly one: featurePath, scenarioText, formToOpen, or compose a list action without any of those three. For a list action, listKind and listName open the list, column and columnValue select a row, buttonTitle or buttonName presses a button, and windowWaitSeconds controls the wait for the opened window. List actions and formToOpen default testManager and testClient to true and refuse false. Reports failed steps and screenshots. Requires vanessa-automation.epf and the 1C thick client configured in EDT preferences. Owned modal observations return blockingWindows with title, texts, buttons and imageFile; nonmodal startup remains unknown. A soft deadline does not ask to raise timeoutSeconds or kill the client.

descriptions.featurePath: File calls: .feature file/directory; alternatives: scenarioText, formToOpen, composed list action. With runKey: no featurePath/scenarioText. projectName resolves relative paths against its project.
descriptions.scenarioText: Gherkin text stored in a temporary run directory; steps depend on Vanessa version. Refused with featurePath.
descriptions.formToOpen: Form name in opening-step syntax; composes a scenario, not combined with featurePath/scenarioText. Add-in captures the test client's top window even when covered.
descriptions.openStep: Opening step: {form} is the name; default opens a common form. List/object/extension forms require version-specific Vanessa wording.
descriptions.startStep: Step acquiring a client; default launches TestClient or attaches to a running one.
descriptions.listName: Name of the metadata object whose list form the scenario opens.
descriptions.tableName: Name of the list's table on the form the steps address (default Список).
descriptions.column: Caption of the column the row to act on is found by.
descriptions.columnValue: Value of that column; an empty string is a value and is looked for as empty.
descriptions.whenSeveral: Matching rows: unique (default) requires exactly one before moving; first moves to the first match.
descriptions.buttonTitle: Button title to press; exactly one of buttonTitle/buttonName.
descriptions.buttonName: Button name to press; exactly one of buttonTitle/buttonName.
descriptions.windowTitle: Expected window title after pressing the button; omitted: wait for a title different from the pre-click title.
descriptions.windowWaitSeconds: Seconds the step that waits for the window waits (default 10).
descriptions.connectionString: 1C infobase connection string, e.g. 'File="C:\\ib";' or 'Srvr="host";Ref="base";'. Omitted: named project's bound infobase, already known to EDT. Server infobase: explicit string required. Pwd refused (client command-line exposure to every process); use password-free or OS authentication. Not accepted with runKey.
descriptions.async: Return runKey without waiting for the run; poll with it for results, or pass runKey and cancel=true to stop the client.
descriptions.runKey: The key from a Pending reply: comes back for that run rather than starting one.
descriptions.cancel: With runKey: stops client and worker processes; prior scenario writes to the infobase remain.
descriptions.waitSeconds: With runKey: how long to wait this time before answering Pending again.
descriptions.vanessaParams: VAParams.json additions as JSON (e.g. tag/scenario filters). Names are Vanessa-version-specific; unknown names ignored. Parameters used by this tool to read results are refused.
descriptions.projectName: Optional EDT project: resolves relative featurePath; its directory is the working directory.
descriptions.timeoutSeconds: Soft observation deadline in seconds (default 300, max 3600); Pending retains the owned client until exit or explicit cancel.
descriptions.infobaseUser: 1C login name for the run. For a base with users, omission opens a login window and the run waits its entire deadline. No password accepted here.
descriptions.testManager: Start as test manager (default true; explicit false is honored for file/text scenarios): required for UI-testing types in form-driving scenarios; otherwise a step returns Тип не определен. List action/formToOpen: omitted=true, false refused.
descriptions.testClient: Include a test client in VAParams for the start step to launch (default false). Without it the TestClient start step has no client; its result has an empty client type and PID 0. List action/formToOpen: omitted=true, false refused.
descriptions.testClientPort: Test client listening port (default 48010); change if another run or EDT holds it.
descriptions.screenshots: Capture a screenshot on step failure (default true).
descriptions.keepOpen: Keep 1C client open for observation (default false); run times out here because the client never exits.
descriptions.vanessaExt: Enable VanessaExt for any input mode. Omitted: enabled for composed form/list actions, unchanged for file/text. Composed actions refuse false; enabling does not prove the add-in is installed.
